The Mercedes GLC is going electric, and we got up close with it in Germany before it makes its way to India.
The new GLC EV brings Mercedes' familiar SUV formula into the electric era, with a completely new design, a new interior, plenty of technology and the kind of proportions that should make it an interesting addition to the luxury EV space.
In this walkaround, we take a closer look at the design, cabin, screens, features, practicality and everything else you need to know about the Mercedes GLC EV ahead of its India launch.
Is this the electric Mercedes we've been waiting for?
